def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    color=next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,3,6))
    shape=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color]
    r0=min(r for r,c in shape); c0=min(c for r,c in shape)
    shape=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in shape]
    sh,sw=max(r for r,c in shape)+1,max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    for dr in range(h-sh+1):
        for dc in range(w-sw+1):
            cells=[(dr+r,dc+c) for r,c in shape]
            if all(grid[r][c]==0 for r,c in cells):
                for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=color
    return out

print(transform(a)==b)
